details.title: Power stage
details.description: The power stage consists of half bridge or full bridge inverter driving the primary tank (LC) circuit of a wireless power transmitter. This stage operates to generate trapezoidal waveform at 50% duty cycle. This stage usually operates at a constant frequency, which is determined by the resonant frequency of the LC parallel resonant circuit.

details.title: Auxiliary power supply
details.description: Auxiliary power supply generally consists of a low voltage DC/DC converter for developing multiple non-isolated rails used to power various subsystems in the end equipment such as digital processor, gate drivers, and sensing circuits. There are multiple optional stages where the output from the main DC/DC converter can be fed to further low voltage DC/DC converters or LDOs. A typical aspect of the auxiliary power supply is its low standby power which is important in improving overall system efficiency.
